description_en: Supports full-page OCR for K12 multi-subject scanning scenarios. The API supports OCR detection of printed text and formulas, returns their coordinates, and also detects the positions of accompanying figures in questions, returning their coordinate locations
description_zh: 支持K12全学科扫描场景的整页内容文字识别。接口支持印刷体文本及公式的OCR识别和坐标返回，此外，接口还可对题目中的配图位置进行检测并返回坐标位置
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-edu-paper-ocr --image-type 'scan：扫描图，_photo：实拍图' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeEduPaperOcr

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you must specify one and only one of them.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; Base64 encoding is not supported)
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you must specify one and only one of them.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en:
Image type.  
scan: Scanned image; photo: Photograph
parameters.help_zh:
图片类型。
scan：扫描图， photo：实拍图
parameters.name: image_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to output the original image coordinate information (for example, if the image has been rotated or corrected). By default, this information is not required.  
true: Required; false: Not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否输出原图坐标信息（如果图片被做过旋转，图片校正等处理），默认不需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
